prompts: Use case: product-mockup. Create a single ultra premium photoreal product-render CUTOUT asset for the Salini native iOS materials feature. Subject: one substantial asymmetric sculptural specimen of warm ivory solid-surface mineral composite (S-Stone), an elegant angular river-stone-sized monolith sliced on an oblique plane. NOT a sphere, not a cookie, not stacked tiles. The polished planar cut face is broad, smooth and homogeneous, with nearly invisible ivory mineral micrograin; outside has exquisite natural broken mineral facets, subtle milky translucency only at very thin edges. The specimen is tilted 25 degrees to show front cut face, thick body, top ridge and deep side volume. A small triangular shoulder makes the silhouette striking. Camera 85mm macro product photography, three-quarter elevated front view, object suspended in air, crisp focus throughout. Light: large soft white key upper left, restrained grazing rim upper right, soft neutral fill, deep dimensional crevices, physically plausible fine surface roughness. Looks like a $100,000 Apple material campaign photographed on a Phase One, sophisticated architectural material, highly tactile and realistic, no low-poly look, no oversharpened noise or sparkles. One object only, centred, fills 76% of a square image with generous clear margins. Absolutely TRANSPARENT background with clean alpha edges. No floor, no cast shadow, no halo, no text, no UI, no labels, no lettering, no pedestal, no other fragments. Isolated image will be animated as a layer with other matching pieces.

Use case: product-mockup. The reference is our lighting/material STYLE REFERENCE for a Salini iOS material composition. Generate a DIFFERENT SEPARATE PIECE matching the same ivory solid-surface stone: a detached thin triangular wedge/fracture fragment, about a third the mass of the reference, elongated diagonal silhouette with one very smooth homogeneous honed cut face and fascinating realistic pale fractured mineral edge. Show its thick profile and finely chipped irregular ridge, suspended, rotated counter-clockwise in three-quarter elevated view. This will fly above-left of the larger stone; it must have a unique angular silhouette, not be a miniature copy of the reference. Same soft upper-left key, subtle upper-right rim, warm ivory, sophisticated Apple campaign/Phase One macro realism, sharp detail, no sparkles. One piece only centered occupying 72% of square canvas, ample margins, transparent background and clean alpha. No floor, shadow, halo, text, border, pedestal, additional objects.

Use case: product-mockup. Reference image is LIGHTING AND RENDER QUALITY only, not the shape. Create a different Salini S-Sense educational material specimen for a native premium iOS app, a single exquisite thick asymmetrical rounded sculptural mass with a diagonal polished cut surface revealing a warm pale mineral-composite interior. The body is cast smoothly, not a natural jagged stone. The large exposed cross-section shows very small densely packed off-white marble grains bound in warm gray-beige resin, fine credible mineral detail, NOT huge terrazzo chips or glitter. Around the cross-section a restrained thin ivory-white Gelcoat band, and a broad smooth ceramic-like glossy white curved exterior wrapping behind it. Show the cross-section in three-quarter elevated front view, the whole object tilted diagonally, enough edge depth and side visible for strong sculptural volume. The form is elegant oblong asymmetric, NOT sphere/egg/disc/cookie. Restrained single softbox reflected on the glossy shell, no overblown highlights. Hyperreal high-end product macro CGI, same soft upper-left light and subtle rim as reference; tactile materially believable, absolutely no text or labels. One object centered occupying 74% of square, generous margins. Transparent background, clean alpha, no floor/cast shadow/halo, no pedestal, no small extra fragments.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the reference asset to make the SAME S-Sense specimen's exterior coating MATTE instead of glossy. Preserve EXACTLY the silhouette, geometry, position, size, cropping, camera, cut-face mineral pattern, colors, alpha outline and all lighting direction. Change only surface roughness of the smooth white exterior shell: a tactile velvety honed matte Gelcoat, soft diffuse light rather than a broad sharp softbox reflection. The inner mineral cross-section and thin white rim must not change. High-end physically credible macro render. Transparent background, no shadows or labels. This image will crossfade over the original, so matching object outline and alignment is essential.

Use case: product-mockup. Reference is the parent S-Sense mineral composite specimen and style/lighting reference. Generate ONLY ONE detached diagonal slice/fragment from its white coated exterior, for an exploded material illustration. Single elegant shallow elongated crescent-wedge with substantial 3D thickness, about one quarter the parent's volume. Broad convex glossy porcelain-white Gelcoat exterior catches one clean elongated softbox reflection; on one side its polished bevel-cut edge exposes fine small ivory marble aggregate in pale warm resin under a thin white surface skin. NOT an empty thin eggshell, not a bathtub, not a complete rounded stone, not a disc. Diagonal silhouette, tilted toward viewer in three-quarter elevated view, top rim visible, readable volume, upper-left key and subtle right rim exactly matching parent. Ultra-real architectural product macro photography with restrained highlights. Transparent background and clean alpha, isolated one piece centred occupying 72% of square image, generous margins. No floor, no cast shadow, no text, no additional objects.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a perfectly aligned MATTE variant of this same S-Sense crescent/wedge material fragment. Change ONLY the surface roughness of its convex white exterior from polished glossy Gelcoat to a velvety smooth matte Gelcoat. Remove the sharp softbox reflection and replace with very soft diffuse shading and exquisite tactile micro-roughness. Preserve EXACTLY the shape, position, camera, alpha silhouette, diagonal direction, colors, exposed fine mineral cross-section, thin rim and dimensions. No change in proportions or framing, this must crossfade over the source. Same physically plausible upper-left illumination. Transparent background, clean alpha, no cast shadow, text or added elements.
